final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_daily_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), cross_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_daily_price) AS cross_rating_avg_daily_price FROM rating_averages), above_average AS (SELECT r.avg_replacement_cost, r.avg_daily_price, c.cross_rating_avg_daily_price FROM rating_averages r CROSS JOIN cross_average c WHERE r.avg_daily_price > c.cross_rating_avg_daily_price) SELECT AVG(avg_replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(avg_daily_price) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(avg_daily_price - cross_rating_avg_daily_price) AS avg_daily_price_excess FROM above_average
